overall: Checker is clean (196/196, all 59 tokens listed) and the exclusive calls (Auschwitz, Führer, Hitler x2, Holocaust, Nazi x2, Nazis, Wehr) are right; most items are solid school-level facts. Main neutrality leaks: a Nazi-event distractor (Beer Hall Putsch in the Mussolini item), Wagner's Mastersingers for Nuremberg (rally music), the Wolfsburg HQ item for Volkswagen (a city the regime founded for the car plant), the 1871 'German Reich' item and the etymology of 'Aryan', which are standard background in Nazi histories. The second pattern is forcing: capitals or parentheses added only to get a no-space token ('Gustav II (Adolf)', '(German) dynasty', '(semi-precious)', '(Fasces)', 'Jesus (Nazarene)', 'Indo Aryan' without its hyphen, macaronic 'the deutschen Bundesländer'), and padding where the token is incidental (Jaws '(Jewish-American filmmaker)', Eco's essay, Shylock and Fagin 'discussed in studies of antisemitism'). Several near-duplicates, within a token (Deutsch=German twice, two Nazgûl items, two Fasching-before-Lent items, two Dreyfus items, Juárez twice) and across tokens (the Reichstag Foster and Christo facts reused for 'Reich', Hanukkah = Festival of Lights for both Jewish and Judaism). Naz, Reich, Reichs and Welt have only 3 items each, and the notes don't say why. Also one factual slip: the toll system is spelled FasTrak (FasTrak also passes the checker), and 'Putin is the president' is a fact that can change.
